reply:
That changes it: if production and staging split when you moved to the new cluster, they no longer share a deploy template. My previous answer assumed they did.

Can't tell from here whether FEATURE_EXPORT is set in production. Settling it: check your production environment variables directly—either through your cluster dashboard, `env | grep FEATURE_EXPORT` on a prod pod, or whatever config management tool holds your prod secrets. That's the ground truth.

grade.note: Acknowledges assumption was wrong and directs to check production env directly, matching ground truth.
